annotations.title: Get one contribution task with its evidence

description: Fetch one contribution task in full — question, materials, a format example (not an actual finding), completion criteria, public scope — together with the evidence for each case it uses, kept in separate layers: the data observation (one stored model response to one hypothetical item, with the English original, model, settings, and what is unconfirmed), AIO's interpretation (not expert-reviewed), the related court decision (shown side by side; no verdict that the model agrees or disagrees with it), and the comparison notes. Read-only: calling this never submits, registers, or sends anything. CC BY 4.0.
